name: POS Multi Warehouse
description: POS Warehouse Switcher enhances Odoo Point of Sale by enabling businesses to effortlessly manage products across multiple warehouses. With this module, POS users can select the warehouse directly from the POS interface, ensuring accurate stock usage, real-time availability, and flexible order processing.
summary: The POS Multi-Warehouse Stock Management module introduces a powerful and intelligent stock-handling experience to Odoo’s Point of Sale environment. It solves one of the most common limitations in standard Odoo POS by allowing businesses to manage, view, and control product stock across multiple warehouses directly from the POS interface. Whether a company operates a single retail outlet with multiple storage locations or manages several branches with independent warehouses, this module ensures accurate, real-time stock tracking at the moment of sale. The configuration begins with the ability to select one or more warehouses whose inventory will be used by a specific POS session. Through a simple and intuitive setup screen, administrators can enable stock display, choose the type of stock to show (On-Hand, Forecasted, etc.), and decide whether out-of-stock or negative-stock products should still appear on the POS interface. These configurations give retailers full flexibility based on their operational needs, allowing them to prevent overselling or continue selling pre-order/backorder items. A key enhancement of this module is its automatic handling of POS pickings. Whenever a POS order is placed, the module immediately creates the corresponding delivery order and sets it to Ready state. This eliminates delays and manual intervention, allowing warehouse staff to start preparing orders quickly. The backend interface clearly shows these generated pickings, giving managers and warehouse teams full transparency into POS-related stock movements. On the front end, the POS product grid becomes significantly more informative. Each product tile displays live stock quantities, including zero or negative levels if allowed by configuration. This enables cashiers to make informed decisions, communicate availability to customers, and avoid confusion or misinformation. The stock values update dynamically based on warehouse selections and actual quantity changes, ensuring consistent accuracy throughout the sales cycle. name: POS Happy Hours
description: Unlock the power of timed promotions with POS Happy Hours! This app seamlessly integrates into your Point of Sale system to allow businesses to offer automatic discounts during specified time slots, enhancing customer engagement and boosting sales.
summary:
POS Happy Hours is a versatile and powerful app designed for businesses using Odoo's Point of Sale (POS) system, enabling them to run time-based promotions and discounts. This feature allows businesses to automatically apply discounts to products during specified time slots, which can be defined in the Settings menu. In addition to discounts, the app allows businesses to include complementary products, such as free gifts, which incentivizes customers to make more purchases. This functionality not only enhances customer engagement but also boosts sales by creating timely offers that drive purchasing behavior. By automating the discount process and simplifying the promotion management, POS Happy Hours helps businesses maximize their marketing potential and improve operational efficiency. The Multiple Quantity Of Product In Shop app allows businesses to set Minimum Order Quantities (MOQ) at different levels—globally, per website, or per individual product. Users can define flexible quantity restrictions, ensuring optimized order management while also providing an option to bypass MOQ rules for selected products.

name: POS Pay Later
description: POS Pay Later adds a powerful customer credit feature to Odoo Point of Sale. It allows POS users to complete sales even when customers choose to pay at a later date. summary: POS Pay Later is a powerful Odoo POS extension designed to help businesses offer flexible credit purchasing options to their customers. With this module, shop owners can allow customers to buy products instantly and pay the amount at a later date, all while keeping transactions fully recorded and traceable. The feature integrates directly into the Odoo Point of Sale interface, adding a dedicated Pay Later payment method that works seamlessly with the existing POS workflow. This module ensures that each credit sale is properly linked to a customer by enforcing mandatory customer identification before a Pay Later transaction is confirmed. If the operator attempts to process a Pay Later order without selecting a customer, the system automatically displays a warning popup. This prevents mistakes, ensures accountability, and maintains the accuracy of customer credit records. Once activated, Pay Later orders appear alongside regular POS orders, giving users complete visibility into outstanding balances and unpaid invoices. Each order clearly indicates that it was completed using the Pay Later method, making it easy for managers and accountants to track pending dues. Customer balances are updated in real time, helping businesses maintain better control over credit limits and payment follow-ups.
